title: Capability Interface Foundation

capability_discovery.name: capability_discovery
capability_discovery.purpose: Describe a capability, category, operations, and support boundaries before execution.
capability_discovery.request: typed discovery query scoped to an installed local connector
capability_discovery.response: opaque capability descriptor with operation and lifecycle metadata
capability_discovery.failure: unknown, unavailable, or untrusted capability is withheld
capability_discovery.cancellation: discovery can be abandoned without starting provider work
capability_discovery.lifecycle: discover, review, expose locally, withdraw, and revoke
capability_discovery.claim_boundary: local contract only; live provider discovery and certification remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL

execution.name: execution
execution.purpose: Define typed request, response, progress, and outcome boundaries for one capability operation.
execution.request: validated operation request with opaque identity and declared scope
execution.response: typed result or redacted failure envelope with no secret payload
execution.failure: invalid, denied, unavailable, or timed-out work returns a typed error
execution.cancellation: in-flight work must observe the cooperative cancellation boundary
execution.lifecycle: accepted, running, completed, failed, cancelled, or revoked
execution.claim_boundary: local contract only; provider execution and release claims remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL

cancellation.name: cancellation
cancellation.purpose: Make cancellation explicit, cooperative, idempotent, and observable as a terminal outcome.
cancellation.request: opaque request or job identity with a cancellation reason
cancellation.response: cancel requested, already terminal, or cancellation unavailable
cancellation.failure: a refused cancellation never masquerades as successful cancellation
cancellation.cancellation: repeated cancellation is safe and does not restart the operation
cancellation.lifecycle: requested, acknowledged, cancelled, completed, or failed
cancellation.claim_boundary: local contract only; live cancellation exercise remains DEFERRED-EXTERNAL

health.name: health
health.purpose: Report capability readiness and limitations without turning absence of evidence into health.
health.request: local health query with a bounded observation window
health.response: status, measured time, source, limitations, and unavailable state
health.failure: unreadable or stale health evidence is reported as unavailable
health.cancellation: health probes can stop without changing capability state
health.lifecycle: unknown, available, degraded, unavailable, or revoked
health.claim_boundary: local contract only; live provider health remains DEFERRED-EXTERNAL

usage.name: usage
usage.purpose: Represent measured or estimated usage with units, period, freshness, source, and availability.
usage.request: usage query for an opaque capability or account scope
usage.response: raw value, unit, period, measured time, source, estimate flag, and availability
usage.failure: missing or stale usage remains unavailable rather than fabricated
usage.cancellation: usage reads may be cancelled without mutating recorded usage
usage.lifecycle: unavailable, measured, estimated, stale, or revoked
usage.claim_boundary: local contract only; live provider usage remains DEFERRED-EXTERNAL

errors.name: errors
errors.purpose: Provide stable, redacted error codes with retryability, user safety, and correlation metadata.
errors.request: error classification from a bounded capability operation
errors.response: safe code, retryable flag, user-safe message key, and opaque correlation id
errors.failure: unknown errors are redacted and classified as unavailable
errors.cancellation: cancellation errors remain distinct from provider or transport errors
errors.lifecycle: created, observed, retried, resolved, or escalated
errors.claim_boundary: local contract only; provider-specific error certification remains DEFERRED-EXTERNAL

lifecycle.name: lifecycle
lifecycle.purpose: Keep discovery, enablement, execution, disablement, and revocation transitions explicit.
lifecycle.request: validated lifecycle transition with an owner and reason
lifecycle.response: accepted transition or fail-closed rejection with current state
lifecycle.failure: invalid or unauthorized transitions do not mutate state
lifecycle.cancellation: pending transitions can be cancelled before side effects begin
lifecycle.lifecycle: declared, reviewed, enabled, disabled, revoked, and removed
lifecycle.claim_boundary: local contract only; installation, provider enablement, and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL

claim_boundary: This is a local capability interface contract, not a live connector implementation.
The contracts describe typed boundaries and fail-closed outcomes without accessing credentials or provider services.
Provider execution, health, usage, certification, signing, release, and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
